en: Listen to this reed as it laments,
It tells tales of separation.
Ever since they cut me from the reed bed,
Both men and women have lamented in my wailing.
Anyone who has strayed from their roots
Seeks to return to the days of union
I lamented in every gathering.
I became a companion to both the distressed and the joyful.
I have been with both the happy and the sad.
I want my heart to be torn apart by separation
So that I may describe the pain of longing
Everyone became my friend based on their own assumptions.
They did not seek my secrets within me.
My secret is not far from my lamentation.
But the eyes and ears lack that light.
The body is not hidden from the soul, nor the soul from the body.
But whoever has seen it, life is not a command.
This sound of the reed is fire, not wind.
Whoever lacks this fire is not alive.
It is the fire of love that has ignited the reed.
It is the fervor of love that makes the reed pipe resonate.
The flute is no match for anyone who has given up on love.
His veils, our veils, were torn.
If the days have passed, it doesn't matter.
Stay, O you, for there is no one purer than you.
Anyone other than a fish gets satiated with its water.
For those without fortune, their day is long overdue.
Break free from your chains, O son.
How long will you be bound by silver and gold chains?
The cup of the greedy's eyes was never filled.
Until the oyster was content, it did not produce a pearl.
Be happy, O our delightful, passionate love!
O Physician of all our ailments!

Be happy, O our delightful, passionate love!
O Physician of all our ailments!
If I were paired with my sympathetic lips,
Like a flute, I would have expressed what I had to say.
Whoever is separated from a kindred spirit
Becomes speechless, even though he has a hundred melodies.
If love does not care for him,
He is like a bird without wings.
How can I be mindful of what comes before and after?
When the light of my beloved is not present, neither before nor after
Love wishes these words were spoken aloud.
The mirror was not a betrayer when it existed.
Do you know why your mirror is not revealing?
Because tarnish is not distinct from its surface.
